===Lore===

Most sorcerers of Hate serve Innoruuk in one of two key roles: The first involves planar travel, shuttling Innoruuk's minions to and from his home plane to both ally and enemy lands — and so is limited to wizards of Hate.

The second but no less important role of the sorcerers of Hate is to cast great spells of destruction against the enemies of Innoruuk, whether those enemies are intruders on the Plane of Hate itself or those the sorcerers have been sent to assault elsewhere.
